name: Soldier of Fortune II: Double Helix

locations.note: The opening is a Cold War flashback: a young John Mullins on an extraction mission in Prague.
The investigation of a viral outbreak starts in the Colombian jungle.
The trail runs through the streets of Hong Kong.
Mullins fights through New York on the way to the people behind the virus.
Near the end of the hunt for the Romulus virus, Mullins protects a summit in Switzerland from attack.
Mullins follows the trail of the Romulus virus into the snows of Kamchatka.
The hunt for Prometheus ends in Texas, after the attack on the summit in Switzerland.

routes.name: John Mullins
routes.note: After a Cold War rescue in Prague, Mullins traces a man-made virus from a Colombian village through Hong Kong, New York and Kamchatka to the attack on the G8 summit in Switzerland, and ends the hunt in Texas.
